title: MCP Warden: a policy, budget and audit gateway for AI agent tool calls
summary: Self-hosted MCP gateway (Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL) enforcing per-agent keys, policy-as-code, rate limits, budgets and human approval on agent tool calls, with a metadata-only audit log, metrics, tracing, Compose stack and threat model.

title: decision-gate: calibrated thresholds and human-in-the-loop routing for AI decision models
summary: Python/FastAPI + PostgreSQL gate for AI decision models: records decisions and outcomes, fits calibrators, selects thresholds that meet an error budget with statistical bounds, routes to auto/verify/human with a review queue, detects drift and compares shadow candidates, with a simulator, worker, Compose stack and end-to-end CI.

title: memory-ledger: a governed, versioned shared memory store for AI agents
summary: Self-hosted Python/FastAPI + PostgreSQL service that gives coding and ops agents one shared, portable memory: scoped, versioned records with supersession and as-of reads, provenance and trust levels, write-time poisoning and secret screening with a quarantine queue, staleness via file-hash anchors and review dates, read receipts that show which memories reached which session, AGENTS.md/MCP-memory/Mem0 import and export, and an MCP server.
